column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3578): forEachChainDialect runs one subtest per dialect (postgres, mysql, mssql), each skipping when its DSN is unset. test-go/plugins sets CLEAT_TEST_DB for PostgreSQL only, so mysql and mssql skip while postgres RUNS. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set: go test ./plugins/auditlog/ -run '^TestAnOperatorHandlersNotedMetadataIsStoredAndHashed$' -count=1 -json reports skip for /mysql and /mssql. multi-db/plugins sets all three DSNs, so nothing skips there. The mysql arm has never run on this machine; it is exercised only by that job.
